question: What event marks the moment of final release at bodily death?
premises: The time is the fall of the body
The skull is pierced at that moment
inference: Final release occurs when the skull is pierced at the body's fall.
uncertainties: The exact yogic process implied by the piercing of the skull is not specified.
plain_english: O Goddess, when at the fall of the body the skull is pierced, then that occurs.
